shape_and_window.weight_shape: Full dimensions are in weight_shape; stored weight/reference arrays use up to weight_output_count × plot_channels.

shape_and_window.statistics_scope: All max_abs, RMS, axis RMS CV and NMSE values are scoped to the plot window. A 512-channel slice does not preserve full-channel token CV; orthogonal rotations preserve total energy only across the complete channel vector.

source_and_parity_boundary.paired_local: Three transforms share the same captured BF16 Linear input; their per-row A4 QDQ values are visualization candidates, not runtime model execution.
source_and_parity_boundary.actual_activation: Each arm uses its own model execution, so differences from paired-local include upstream arm effects.
